# `jouet setup`

- **Usage:** `jouet setup [FLAGS] <HARNESS>`

Install jouet's hooks into a coding agent's harness

Merges hooks into Claude Code's settings.json, Codex's hooks.json, Cursor's hooks.json, Gemini CLI's settings.json or Copilot's hooks/jouet.json, keeping every other hook. The session-start hook primes each session with the commands and rules, so the skill, which says the same, is installed only with --skill or when priming is off ([hooks] prime). Running it again changes nothing. The jouet-init project onboarding skill is always installed; --uninstall removes only what jouet added. The hooks do nothing where jouet is not on PATH.

## Arguments
- **`<HARNESS>`** — claude, codex, cursor, gemini or copilot

## Flags
- **`--global`** — Install for every project, under your home directory (the default)
- **`--project`** — Install into this repository for you alone: Claude Code's untracked .claude/settings.local.json
- **`--shared`** — Install into the repository's tracked hooks file (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks.json, .gemini/settings.json or .github/hooks/jouet.json), for everyone who clones it (implies --project)
- **`--dry-run`** — Show what would change without writing anything
- **`--uninstall`** — Remove jouet's hooks and skills
- **`--skill`** — Install the skill as well, which the session-start primer otherwise stands in for
- **`--benchmark`** — Print a prompt for an agent to benchmark jouet on this project
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
